label: Paper Cut
mood: calm, crafted, seasonal — a layered cut-paper diorama (hills or waves, a pale sun or a moon with paper halo rings, little clouds and pines) seen through a round or arched window in a sheet of the poster's colour, each layer casting a soft shadow. Good for children's and family events, cultural programmes, seasonal greetings, markets, travel and nature themes.

window.note: circle | arch — shape of the opening the diorama sits in

edge.note: hills (rolling ridges, with pines) | waves (regular sea swell)

disc.note: plain sun / moon disc behind the far ridge (no rays). Pale soft yellow / apricot on a light sky; on a dark sky the accent colour, or pale moon-yellow if the accent is red

rings.note: concentric paper halo rings around the disc (0–3)

trees.note: number of little pines cut into one ridge (0 = none; hills only)

depth.note: spacing between sheets: 0.6 = shallow, subtle shadows … 1.6 = deep shadow box

shadow.note: shadow softness in degrees: 4 = crisp … 25 = very soft

reverse.note: false = pale sky, deep foreground (light posters) · true = deep night sky with stars, pale hills (automatic on dark backgrounds)

grain.note: paper fibre relief: 0 = smooth card (renders ~15% faster) … 2 = rough handmade paper

stars.note: punched-out stars in the night sky (only when the sky is dark)
